meta.name: bell_ridge_village
meta.prompt: A feudal Japanese hill village of terraced paddies, with a great bronze temple bell in its own pavilion on the ridge above, rung at dusk.

programs.brief: A traditional Japanese open timber bell pavilion (shōrō) with heavy cedar posts, curved irimoya eave roof, a massive cast bronze temple bell (bonshō) suspended from crossbeams, and a suspended swinging log striker (shumoku).

tokens.terrain: a steep hillside village surrounded by terraced rice paddies, rising to a prominent ridge overlooking the valley
tokens.icons: a great bronze temple bell hung in an open timber pavilion on the high ridge; stepped water paddies on stone-retained terraces; stone lanterns along climbing stone stairs
